function.arguments: {"reason": "The initial raw difference in response rates was confounded by severity: the treatment group had a much higher proportion of severe cases, which are associated with lower response rates. This would bias the raw difference downward. To correct for this, I stratified the analysis by severity and computed within-stratum treatment effects. Then, I computed a weighted average of these effects using the overall distribution of severity in the sample. This adjusted estimate (0.143) is a valid estimate of the treatment effect after accounting for the confounding by severity."}
function.name: resolve_finding
